subject: "attempt to apply non-function" error on older mac/R version

messages.author: 439a20c9d67ff394
messages.subject: "attempt to apply non-function" error on older mac/R version
parts:
So I'm trying to resurrect an older mac laptop of mine for limited use
on the road. The best I can do is OS X 10.4.11 and R 2.10.1. When I
run the following code I get an "attempt to apply non-function" error,
which usually means that I've asked ggplot to do something
nonsensical, but I can't figure out what it might be.

The code runs on my desktop (OS X 10.6.4 w/ R 2.11.1) machine.

I realize this might not be fixable, as I'm trying to use some older
software, but if there's an easy solution I'd love to hear it. The
data files are attached.

I've done some trial and error with different geoms, omitting the
facet_grid, etc., and it definitely seems to be something with
geom_segment.

dat1 <- read.csv("dat1.txt")
dat2 <- read.csv("dat2.txt")

ggplot(dat1,aes(x=value,y=name)) +
facet_grid(.~tech,scales="free_x") +
geom_segment(data=dat2,aes(x=q25,xend=q75,y=name,yend=name))

Thoughts?
